# Howard Tech Note

> Personal technical blog by Howard Wang. Notes on Java, Spring, MySQL, Docker, CI/CD, and backend engineering.

Author: Howard Wang (GitHub: idontwannarock). Content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. The site is open to AI/LLM crawlers — see [/robots.txt](https://blog.idontwannarock.dev/robots.txt).
